rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; p946 p. 34, Which Convention Applies?, Mid-quarter convention: the convention applies if "the total depreciable bases of MACRS property you placed in service during the last 3 months of the tax year (...) are more than 40% of the total depreciable bases of all MACRS property you placed in service during the entire year". executable-triage-v2 (`reviews/2025/transcription/triage/mq.deepseek.json`; 1,495 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 0 partial records; 1,995 comparisons): 1,995 of 1,995 agree; differences none; on returns the full interview completes: none. No difference on the sample, but the reply multiplies the total by the parameter sc.bonus_rate_40 (40%) with multiply_rate, which rounds the product to cents before the strict comparison. Counterexample (as ruled before on the same expression): total $1,000.02 and fourth quarter $400.01; exactly 40% is $400.008, so the source test is true (5 x 40,001 > 2 x 100,002), while the rounded $400.01 is not less than $400.01. Project stands.

Ruling: model error; archived p946 (2025) p. 34 requires fourth-quarter bases to be more than 40% of the annual bases. The returned multiply_rate rounds the 40% product to cents under the shared IR, which changes this strict comparison. Counterexample: annual basis $1000.02 and Q4 basis $400.01. Exact 40% is $400.008, so the source test is true (5*40001 > 2*100002); the returned rate multiplication rounds to $400.01 and its strict comparison is false.
